description: Operational overseas nuclear installations is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy. World Nuclear Associatoin database of operational nuclear installations. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy. The portal shows 2016-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
